Subject: Strange connection handshakes during demo (kv-cache mismatch)

Hi Logan —

Quick note after this morning's demo: our integration intermittently fails during long-context sessions. The client sees repeated 5xxs with the error 'kv-cache mismatch' after ~90s of streaming; reconnecting fixes it temporarily. We attached a small kv dump and the SDK logs. This is blocking our pilot — Amit is on the call and can confirm the repro.

Can your team triage? We're under a tight timeline for SSO + contract sign-off (attached redlines).

Thanks,
Mia Park
Head of ML Integrations, Quantimetrics

Subject: Re: Strange connection handshakes during demo (kv-cache mismatch)

Thanks for the repro, Mia.

High level: sounds like a KV cache serialization/version skew during long-lived streaming connections. Dev/Sean — can you confirm whether the connector fallback is triggering a cold-start path that might be incompatible with their cached prefix? If this is a model variant routing issue we may need a short-term routing exception to keep them on the older variant until we push a compatibility fix.

Priority: pilot renewal in two weeks, so I want to keep the customer running safely while engineering digs into root cause.

Action items:
- Dev: can you triage logs and repro asap and propose a mitigation?
- Sean: can you prepare an internal brief for a temporary routing exception and cost impact?
- Marissa: flag for potential deal support if we need credits / SLA tweak.

—Logan
Account Exec — Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mia Park <mia@quantimetrics.io>, Amit Shah <amit@acme-corp.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 13:27:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Strange connection handshakes during demo (kv-cache mismatch)

Repro steps and quick findings:
- I replayed the attached kv dump against our staging runtime. We see an assert in the prefetch layer where cached KV IDs don't match the active descriptor after a routing fallback.
- Root cause (likely): a rare race when a request is routed mid-stream from a prefetch-optimised host to a fallback host that expects a different cache layout (happens when the cluster triggers a variant promotion/demotion).

Short-term mitigations I can push today (low-risk):
1) Disable mid-stream variant routing for sessions with active KV cache (sticky variant routing for the session lifetime) — will slightly reduce autoscaling flexibility but prevents state mismatch.
2) Add a short retry wrapper at the SDK side that attempts a connection reset and explicit cache re-sync on that specific 5xx.

I can implement (1) as a config toggle per-customer. Recommend we enable for Quantimetrics while we implement a proper compatibility layer (ETA ~2 weeks).

Logs & trace: https://sentry.example/issues/quantimetrics-2987 (similar traces).

—Dev
Senior Runtime Engineer

Estimate for routing-exception impact: enabling sticky-variant-for-session for Quantimetrics will reduce our ability to reclaim nodes on burst windows; expected monthly cost delta for their pilot at current usage is about ~$1.2k/month (rough estimate). No infra contract changes required — this is a platform config toggle.

I'll draft the short internal change request and the rollback plan. If Sales OKs, we can flip it today and monitor.

Also: recommend adding a short note to the PS onboarding checklist to set this flag for long-context streaming POCs until compatibility layer ships.

—Sean
